Hi Priya / Samir —

Thanks again for the intro yesterday. Solaris moving to the AWS Marketplace and onboarding with our listed SI partner is great news — we'd like to lock a joint session to cover: marketplace listing walk-through, quick product demo (25-30m), and a technical ops runbook for deployment/metrics (45-60m).

High-level asks for this thread:
- Confirm who from Solaris will join the technical deep-dive (Samir?)
- Confirm if an AWS Marketplace uplift rep should join (I've CC'd the AWS Partner Events alias — please add any specific AWS contact)
- Pick 1-2 time slots next week (we’ll split into an exec/overview + a technical block if you prefer)

Proposed windows (all in PDT):
- Tue 2027-03-16: 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30
- Thu 2027-03-18: 09:00–10:30 or 13:00–14:30

Attached: Solaris_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW stub) and agenda-marketplace-onboarding-v0.3.docx — feel free to edit.

If you'd prefer one long session instead of two, say so and we’ll adapt.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Partner Sales
Redwood Inference

+1 415-555-0123

- We definitely want an AWS rep on the call to confirm listing checklist and EULA items. The aws-partner alias is fine to start; I’ll add our internal Marketplace ops contact if needed.
- Prefer splitting into two back-to-back blocks: 30m exec/overview + 60m technical.

Availability (all times PST):
- Tue 2027-03-16: 11:30–13:00 (Samir still in transit until ~14:00 PST)
- Thu 2027-03-18: 16:30–18:30 (this hits late evening for APAC but Samir can dial in)

If neither is workable, we can target Mon 2027-03-22 morning PST.

Also: are there any pre-reads we should circulate? The SOW looks fine — I’ll have legal scan it but don’t expect major redlines.

- Exec overview: 16:30–17:00 PST (23:30–00:00 CET / 05:00–05:30 IST 03/19)
- Technical deep-dive: 17:00–18:00 PST (00:00–01:00 CET / 05:30–06:30 IST 03/19)
